db_version: v2.7-template (FollowerIntegritySkill v0.5 rules; empty: no clusters, indicators or watch list ship with the template)
rules: A cluster is CONFIRMED only with >= 1 STRONG shared fingerprint OR >= 3 independent MODERATE shared fingerprints.
A STRONG fingerprint must have its value recorded (the actual text, domain, ID, wallet or destination). If value is UNKNOWN, engine.py grades it as MODERATE until the value is recorded.
A shared topic, theme, opinion, slogan, claimed location, or public-figure name is never a fingerprint (is_topic_or_slogan = true entries are listed for transparency and ignored).
Copying the same PUBLIC source (for example a celebrity's real bio) is a WEAK persona-template fingerprint, because unrelated copycats produce it independently.
Cluster membership only moves NETWORK_COORDINATION. It never raises AUTOMATION, SPAM, SCAM, IMPERSONATION or DECEPTION by itself.
CANDIDATE clusters (below the bar) have NETWORK_COORDINATION capped at 49 and are shown as '<id> (candidate)'.

v0.5: IDENTICAL_POST_SAME_DATE (an identical non-stock caption published by 2+ accounts on the same calendar date) is STRONG only with its value, its date and 2+ named accounts in the fingerprint's members; otherwise it is graded MODERATE.
v0.5: the same posting-date sequence across accounts is a MODERATE CONTENT_SEQUENCE fingerprint (day-level; it never raises AUTOMATION by itself; A008 needs minute/hour windows).

v0.5: when fingerprints list their members, every cluster member must directly share at least one MODERATE+ fingerprint; a member linked only by WEAK fingerprints is treated as candidate-only (NET capped at 49).
v0.5: SUPERSEDED clusters stay in the file for history (status SUPERSEDED, superseded_by) and are ignored by engine.py.

fingerprint_types.DOMAIN: STRONG (if the domain is not a mainstream site)
fingerprint_types.DUPLICATE_PHRASE: MODERATE (WEAK if the phrase is a widely used stock line)

NOTE: Each install builds its own fingerprint clusters from its own collected evidence. The template ships the rules and fingerprint types only; no accounts, domains, wallets or destinations from anyone else's audit.
